verdict.rationale: Postman documents a built-in AI assistant, Agent Mode (plus Postbot), that takes natural-language instructions and acts on them in the product. Documented tasks include sending requests, fixing errors, updating tests, adding tests, visualizing responses and writing documentation. Postbot usage is capped at 50 activities per user per month on free use, and wider access requires buying an add-on. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Mode's delegation quality, and in-depth docs on the scope and limits of autonomous actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: With Agent Mode, you can turn your words into action across the API lifecycle. Send requests, fix errors, update tests, and more, using natural language.
You can ask Agent Mode to add tests to requests, visualize responses, write documentation, and more.
Postbot is free to try on all Postman plans . Monthly usage is limited to 50 activities per user.
